items.name: Belgorod Open 2018
items.information: All 18 events! Registration will be closed at midnight on September, 17 or when we reach 250 competitors. Spectators are welcome and do not need to register or pay. Registration fee: * **150 RUB**(~2.3 USD) for any one event (for ex. 3x3x3 Cube only) (or 100 RUB using prepayment); * **250 RUB** (~3.9 USD) for equal or less than 8 events (or 200 RUB using prepayment);; * **350 RUB** (~5.4 USD) for 9 - 18 events (or 300 RUB using prepayment);; If you do not see your name on the compeitors table after 48 hours of registering, please [contact us](mailto:ruslan.chaika@mail.ru,robota.av@gmail.com) to resolve the issue. Visit the competition [website](https://vk.com/belgorodopen2018) for more details.
